findings: Invalid transform-list separators are accepted: `transform_parse` uses `skip_path_separators` at the start of each iteration, which consumes commas without requiring them to separate two transforms. Inputs such as `transform=",translate(1)"` or `transform="translate(1),,scale(2)"` can therefore decode successfully. This conflicts with the requirement to reject invalid transform syntax; the existing malformed-transform tests do not cover it. See `src/svg/shape/shape.c:398-399` and `src/svg/shape/shape.c:459-466`.
summary: The supplied deterministic checks support the reported build, sanitizer, fuzz, renderer-comparison, and corpus results. The pending STATE/LEDGER status and preflight-only ledger block are expected. The invalid transform-list syntax gap prevents acceptance.
